auth_url.description: OpenStack Keystone v3 base URL, e.g. https://identity.example.com:5000 or http://controller:5000. The /v3/auth/tokens, /v3/projects, /v2.0, /v3/{project_id}/volumes, and /v2/{project_id} endpoints are appended to this base.

identityEndpoint.description: Alias for auth_url (matches OpenStack SDK terminology).

region.description: OpenStack service-catalog region. If set, every queried service must expose a matching public endpoint; cross-region fallback is rejected.

project_name.description: Default Keystone project name to scope tokens against.

timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout in milliseconds for both Keystone auth and upstream API calls.

maxResponseBytes.description: Maximum accepted upstream response size in bytes.

allowInsecureHttp.description: Allow http:// auth_url values for private deployments. Defaults to false (http:// is rejected).

skipTlsVerify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for private deployments.
